# mxroute_domain_pointer (Resource)

Manage a domain alias or redirect. Reference the parent domain resource to order creation and cleanup. Pointer verification prerequisites are live-unverified and are checked independently of the parent when the optional DNS preflight is enabled. Identity and mode changes require replacement; do not assume create-before-destroy works for a unique pointer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mxroute_domain_pointer" "example" {
  domain  = mxroute_domain.example.domain
  pointer = "alias.example.net"
  type    = "alias"

  # Opt in only when a TXT verification record is published for this pointer.
  verification_wait_seconds = 900
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Owned parent domain; changing it replaces the pointer.
- `pointer` (String) Canonical pointer DNS name; changing it replaces the pointer.

### Optional

- `type` (String) alias (default) or redirect. Changing mode replaces the pointer.
- `verification_wait_seconds` (Number) Opt-in DNS TXT preflight for the pointer name itself, independent of its parent (0 disables, maximum 1800). No API validation errors are retried.
- `visibility_wait_seconds` (Number) Bound post-create list visibility polling in seconds (0 checks once; maximum 1800).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account-relative domain/pointer identity.
- `target` (String) Server-reported target domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mxroute_domain_pointer.example example.com/alias.example.net
```
